entities.summary: Juan Ladrillero was a 16th-century Spanish navigator and explorer who from 1557 to 1559 explored the coast of Chile from Valdivia to the Barbara Channel. He was the first to navigate the Strait of Magellan from its western entrance to its eastern and back again.
